This mod uses [color=#ffd966]Alternative Textures[/color] (AT) to retexture the [color=#ffd966]wooden lamp-post[/color] into animated floating stars.

If you're new to alternative textures (AT), you should go to Robin's shop and buy the [color=#ffd966]paint bucket[/color]. Then, use the paint bucket to change the texture of 'wooden lamp-post'. 

The recipe (50 wood; 1 battery) for 'Wooden lamp-post' can be bought from Robin.

[b]DISCLAIMER[/b]: one size only. I only enlarged the middle star in the GIF to clearly show it.[/font]

Manifest.Name: Star Lamp
